title: Activity Camps — Art, LEGO, Science, Theater & More
description: Half-day themed camps at community centers citywide. Themes include animation, art, carpentry, D&D, fishing, jewelry, LEGO, pottery, science, sports, and theater. Scholarships available.

title: Licensed School-Age Summer Day Camp
description: Full-day licensed childcare with field trips and weekly themes, June 22 through August 27. Accepts DCYF Working Connections, CCAP, and Best Starts for Kids subsidies.

title: Nature Adventure Trek at Discovery Park
description: Four habitats — freshwater, saltwater, forest, and meadow — explored through hands-on activities, songs, crafts, and games. Two miles of protected beach and dramatic sea cliffs.

title: After-School & Break Art Classes
description: Seattle's oldest locally-owned art school for children, established 1982. After-school, school-break, summer camp, and homeschool classes on Sunnyside Ave N.

title: Backyard Studio Art Intensives
description: Fifteen years running. Classes in a backyard painting studio with big doors opening onto a shady, tree-lined yard. Professional artist instruction and very small groups.

title: Creative Arts Classes & Open Studio
description: Art and play combined. Alongside classes there are open-studio hours and a playroom stocked with toys and art supplies — useful when you have siblings at different ages.

title: Process Art in the Magic Art Tent
description: Process-based art in a distinctive outdoor setting, including a heated and lit wedding-style tent. Toddler time, school-age classes, and birthday parties.

title: Youth Drawing, Painting & Sculpture
description: Serious instruction in drawing, painting, sculpture, and alternative media at one of Seattle's most respected art institutions. Students experiment widely across techniques.

title: Pottery Wheel & Clay Classes
description: A cozy home studio near Salmon Bay School — you'll know it by the fence decorated with whimsical masks. Kids make bowls, cups, vases, games, and fairy houses.

title: Studio Art for Kids & Teens
description: Julie and Greta believe creative expression matters more than ever. Small classes in a warm neighborhood studio on West McGraw Street.

title: Art Classes for Young Artists
description: Students learn techniques of the grand masters across tempera, acrylic, and watercolor. One parent reports their child asks about art class literally every day.

title: Private Kids Art Classes
description: Private instruction across various art mediums in a quiet, comfortable, professional atmosphere. Students range from kindergarten through eighth grade.

title: Year-Round Swim Lessons
description: Indoor pool with year-round lessons from 6 months through teens. Group, private, and semi-private options.

title: Summer Swim Lessons
description: Seasonal outdoor pool with summer lessons for ages 2 through adult. Email for private lesson availability.

title: Swim Lessons — 8 Progressive Stages
description: The largest swim lesson provider in the country. Instructors hold national certifications in instruction, CPR, AED, and First Aid. Financial assistance available.

title: Parent & Tot Through Advanced Youth Swim
description: Indoor pool kept at 85 degrees with two diving boards. Parent/tot through advanced youth lessons, plus synchronized swimming.

title: Beach-Side Swim Lessons at Colman Pool
description: Seasonal outdoor pool with Puget Sound views, a diving board, and a tube slide. Bring a bucket and shovel — the beach is right there.

title: Preschool & Youth Swim Lessons
description: Parent and child, preschool (3-5), and youth (6-12) lessons, plus pre-competitive and diving. Daily morning and evening sessions in summer.

title: Youth Soccer, Basketball, T-Ball & Volleyball
description: Recreational leagues built around participation over competition. Soccer, baseball, volleyball, basketball, and cheer across multiple branches.

title: After-School Climbing Program
description: Climbing, activities, discovery, and social time — no experience needed. Also runs school-break camps at Fremont, University District, and South Seattle gyms.

title: Multi-Sport Day Camp
description: Creative sports games where counselors work actively alongside kids. One parent called it organized recess with great counselors — equally fun across ability levels.

title: Youth Sports Leagues — Ages 4 to 14
description: Baseball, basketball, flag football, and soccer leagues emphasizing good sportsmanship and equal playing time. Seasons run year-round.

title: Public Skating & Learn to Skate
description: Daily public skating sessions for all ages and skill levels at the Kraken's community rink. Free for kids under 3. Helmets highly recommended.

title: Indoor Skatepark Lessons
description: The city's only indoor skatepark — 6,900 square feet of ledges, manual pads, quarter pipes, banks, rails, and a vert wall. Boards, helmets, and pads provided.

title: Coding, AI & Robotics — CREATE Program
description: Kids build video games and debug real code through structured hands-on lessons that feel like play. Holds the ISTE Seal of Approval.

title: LEGO Robotics & Engineering Classes
description: STEAM programs using LEGO bricks and robotics. Curriculum supports children of all abilities, including sensory sensitivities and autism spectrum considerations.

title: Summer Tech Camp at UW
description: Coding, game dev, robotics, and 3D printing on the UW campus, with breaks for ultimate frisbee and capture the flag on the university's fields.

title: Scratch, Python & Game Design
description: Learn to code, code to learn. Multiple locations across the Seattle area with morning and afternoon camp options, plus school-year classes.

title: LEGO Robotics & Minecraft Camps
description: Small, focused camps built around LEGO robotics and coding. Younger students build motorized vehicles and creatures; older kids go deeper into robotics and Scratch.

title: Hands-On Science Camps
description: Camps at a Seattle institution operating since the 1962 World's Fair, home to a saltwater tide pool, butterfly garden, science playground, and IMAX theater.

title: Private Music Lessons — 15 Instruments
description: Guitar, piano, drums, bass, voice, ukulele, strings, woodwinds, brass, harp, mandolin, and banjo. MiniMeter classes serve babies from 6 months with a caregiver.

title: Private Lessons — Piano, Guitar, Drums, Voice
provider: Off the Wall School of Music
description: Kids walk out of the first lesson able to play something to impress their friends. Four weekly half-hour private lessons per month in piano, guitar, drums, bass, voice, or violin.

title: Performance-Based Music Program
description: The philosophy is that the best way to learn music is to play it. Weekly private lessons paired with band rehearsals. Little Wing program serves ages 2 to 5.

title: Lessons with Working Musicians
description: Faculty of fifteen professional working musicians. Guitar, piano, voice, ukulele, violin, woodwinds, banjo, mandolin, bass, drums, and flute — students can switch instruments.

title: Drum Instruction — All Levels
description: Founded 1986. A vocational music school offering serious drum instruction from beginner through pre-professional, plus summer drum camps.

title: Music FunTime — Early Childhood Music
provider: Ballard Academy of Music and Dance
description: An internationally acclaimed early childhood program based on Johns Hopkins research. Thirty-minute classes of 2 to 6 students, theory-based, with violins, guitars, and drums.

title: Ballet, Tap, Jazz, Modern & Pop Styles
description: More than 30 years in Northeast Seattle. Classes are gender-neutral, non-competitive, and supportive of all body types. Strength, flexibility, alignment, and artistry.

title: Dance Classes — Ballet Through K-Pop
description: One of the most diverse dance lineups in the Pacific Northwest — ballet, hip hop, K-pop, flamenco, Irish, and musical theater. Try a free class; make up missed classes free.

title: Dance, Acting & Music at the Junction
description: Four studios in the heart of the Alaska Junction. Ballet, jazz, modern, hip hop, piano, voice, and musical theater, with performances throughout the year.

title: Ballet, Tap, Jazz & Hip Hop
provider: Ballard Academy of Music and Dance
description: Preschool through advanced classes in ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, modern, and contemporary. Serving north Seattle, Shoreline, and Edmonds families.

title: Westlake Dance — Jazz, Hip Hop, Lyrical
description: Open since 1993. Acro, tap, ballet, pointe, jazz, lyrical, contemporary, hip hop, musical theater, pre-ballet, and combination classes.

title: Drama School — Acting, Musical Theatre & Improv
description: Year-round classes at the Adrienne Dillard-Coons Drama School. Students build characters and invent original plays through collaborative storytelling. Off-site locations too.

title: Youth Productions at the Bathhouse Theatre
description: Full-scale productions for grades 1 through 12 in the Bathhouse Theatre alongside Green Lake. No auditions required — kids problem-solve staging as a team.

title: Junior & Full-Length Musical Productions
description: Junior productions for ages 5 to 10 and full-length shows for ages 11 to 18. Known for elaborate costumes and sets. Families contribute volunteer time or buy out the requirement.

title: Kids Karate & Little Dragons
description: Traditional karate and practical self-defense in age-specific classes. Little Dragons builds listening skills and focus for the youngest students. Spring and summer camps too.

title: Kids Mixed Martial Arts
description: Kids learn both striking and grappling — the combination that matters for real self-defense. Programs designed around focus, discipline, and rank advancement.

title: Children's Karate & Kickboxing
description: Operating since 2001. Karate, kickboxing, and self-defense in a supportive environment focused on confidence, resilience, and respect alongside technique.

title: YMCA Karate — Graded Skill Series
description: A graded series of increasing skill and complexity across Seido, Shindo-Jinen-Ryu, Shotokan, and Goju Ryu disciplines. Financial assistance available.

title: Gymnastics, Dance & Karate for Little Ones
provider: The Little Gym of West Seattle
description: Gymnastics, dance, karate, sports skills, and Kindermusik under USA Gymnastics guidelines. WonderKids Club adds arts and crafts, story time, and LEGO DUPLO play.

title: Pre-K Dance & Gymnastics
provider: The Little Gym of Maple Leaf
description: Foundational dance technique from ballet to jazz and hip hop, with creative movement emphasizing rhythm, muscle memory, and counting. Book a risk-free intro class.

title: Kinder Camp at the Zoo
description: Games, activities, and animal encounters with routes kept short for little legs. Each day has a theme — colors, numbers, families. Half day for 3-4s, full day for 4-5s.

title: Zoo Camps — Tiny Turtles to Eco Explorers
description: Wildlife-themed camps teaching STEAM skills, scientific inquiry, and global conservation. Extended day care and financial assistance available.

title: Itty Bitty Camps — Parent & Child Nature
description: A parent-and-child nature program based out of Discovery Park. Only $30 per session to add a sibling, which makes it workable for families with more than one little one.

title: Outdoor Nature Immersion Classes
description: Affordable, nature-rich outdoor preschool classes operating in Seattle parks through a partnership with Seattle Parks and Recreation. Kids count acorns instead of marbles.

title: Fiddleheads Forest School
description: An outdoor classroom in the Washington Park Arboretum where children foster a love of science alongside social and emotional development.

title: Nature-Based Preschool & Roots of Connection
description: Three play- and nature-based programs with fenced yards and indoor play areas. Kids alternate between Matthews Beach Park explorations and a sandpit, playhouse, and fairy garden.

title: Environmental Learning at Camp Long
description: A 68-acre Seattle Parks site with a climbing rock, trails, and rustic cabins. Programs build the next generation of environmental stewards.

title: Youth Rowing & Sailing Camps
description: Learn to row or sail on Lake Washington. A Seattle Parks facility with its own registration timeline, separate from general camp registration.

title: Small Craft & Paddling Camps
description: Canoeing, kayaking, rowing, and sailing on Green Lake. Registration opens later than general Seattle Parks camps, so watch the date.

title: Summer Camp — Academic & Arts Blocks
description: Four instructional blocks daily with lunch provided, drawing campers from across Seattle and internationally. Boarding available for ages 12 to 16.

title: Summer Day Camp
description: Long-running Seattle childcare provider running full-summer day camp with weekly themes at school and community sites across the city.

title: Investigative Learning Camps
description: Computing, game creation, robotics, and Python for students in fifth grade and up. Themes and lessons differ by level through grades 6 to 8.

title: After-School Enrichment Classes
description: Active after-school classes supporting Seattle-area schools with quality care and sports activities. Runs at school sites across the city.

title: Rhythmic Gymnastics Camp
description: Multilingual coaches teach ballet, ribbon, hoops, and tumbling alongside free play, games, and crafts. Only one week offered per age group in July.

title: Year-Round Swim Lessons
description: Year-round lessons in a warm 90°F pool with a 4:1 student-to-instructor ratio. Programs range from Aqua Babies through competitive preparation, focused on water safety and building confidence.

title: Group & Private Swim Lessons
description: Eight-stage progressive swim curriculum at 10+ locations across Seattle. Group and private lessons available for all skill levels, from water introduction through stroke refinement. Financial assistance available.

title: Private & Semi-Private Swim Instruction
description: Small-group and private swim instruction at indoor pools in Magnolia and Crown Hill. Sold in packages of 8 lessons (summer) or 10 lessons (fall/winter/spring). Experienced coaches, individualized feedback.

title: Youth Swim Lessons
description: Small-group swim lessons at Seattle University's indoor pool for ages 3–13. Focused on stroke development, water safety, and building confidence in the water.

title: Pool & Beach Swim Lessons
description: Group swim lessons at Rainier Beach Pool, Mounger Pool, and Colman Pool for ages 6 months and up. Free beach swim lessons for ages 6–16 at all lifeguarded beaches each summer.

title: Semi-Private & Private Swim Lessons
description: Flexible-schedule semi-private and private swim instruction in North Seattle and the Eastside. Monthly packages for all levels from water introduction through competitive stroke work.

title: Year-Round Swim Lessons & Open Swim
description: Community pool in Crown Hill offering year-round swim lessons in small classes for ages 2 and up. Monthly membership-based pricing with open swim times for families.

title: Year-Round Swim Lessons
description: Gentle, survival-first approach to swim instruction across 6+ Seattle-area locations including West Seattle, Bothell, and the Eastside. Year-round lessons for ages 3 months and up at indoor pools.
